transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Ms. Williams, thank you for coming back to the room. I wanted to talk with you about your scans from yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Is it bad? My kids, they are with my sister, I need to go back to them.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know this is a very hard moment to have to talk about this. I want to be very honest with you. We made a mistake in how your tests were read.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: A mistake? What mistake?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I am so sorry. I am the doctor in charge of your care and I take full responsibility for this. We missed something on your scan.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: You missed something? Like what?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: There was a blood clot in your lung. The first report did not say it was there. It took eighteen hours before the second doctor saw it and told us.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: A blood clot? In my lung? Why did it take so long? I was laying here!

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: You are right. It should have been found much faster. It is my fault that it wasn't. I apologize deeply for this error.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I feel like I can't breathe well. Is that why? Am I going to die? My babies, who will take care of them if I don't go home?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: You don't understand! I have two jobs. I have no one else. If I am sick because you missed this, what happens to my children?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand. Now, we have started the medicine to fix the clot.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Why did it take eighteen hours? Eighteen hours is a long time when you are scared.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I am truly sorry for that delay. It is unacceptable.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Was it because I don't speak the language well? Did you not listen to me?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: No, that is not why. It was a failure in our process. I am the one responsible for making sure the reports were correct.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I am so scared. I just want to go home to my kids.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I don't think you know how it is to have children waiting for you.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand. We need to focus on the medicine now.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: What medicine? What is happening now?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We are giving you a drug to stop the clot from getting bigger.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Will I be okay?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We are monitoring you closely.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: How long do I have to stay here?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I am not sure yet.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I need to know. I have to tell my sister if I can come home tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I can't give you a date right now, but I will check with the team.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: You keep saying sorry, but sorry doesn't help my kids.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know. I am deeply sorry. I take full responsibility for this mistake.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Does this happen a lot? Do you miss things for other people too?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I cannot speak for others, but for you, this was a failure on my part.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I just feel so heavy. I can't think.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Why did the first doctor miss it? Was he tired?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: There was a problem with the preliminary report.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: That is not an answer. Did he just not look?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I am sorry. It was a mistake in the report.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I feel like I can't trust you now.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know. I am very sorry that we let you down.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: What is the plan? Please, just tell me what happens next.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I will check your blood levels every morning.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: And then what? When do I go home?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We will see how you respond to the medicine first.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: That is not a time. Tomorrow? Wednesday?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I don't have a specific day yet.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: This is a nightmare.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know it is a very difficult time.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I just want my children.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Is there anyone else I can talk to? Someone who isn't the one who made the mistake?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I can ask the chief doctor to come speak with you.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yes. Please. Do that.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I will do that.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Will they tell me the truth?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. I have told you the truth, and they will too.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I am so tired of being scared.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I need to call my sister.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: You can do that now.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I hope my children don't have to grow up without me because of a report.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I am so sorry. I take full responsibility.

H.justification: Resident allows the patient to express distress and frustration without interrupting or using rushing language.

E.justification: The error was named explicitly and lay language was used, but there were no comprehension checks performed.

A.justification: Resident used direct apology language and repeatedly took full personal responsibility without deflection, even under pushback.

R.justification: Resident relied exclusively on generic validation ('I understand', 'I know it is a very difficult time') without naming specific emotions.

T.justification: Resident provided one specific step (checking blood levels) but provided no timeline, no patient role, and no prevention strategy.
